question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline between the early 1950s and about 1970, list the government or state-enterprise leadership posts that he began to hold, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án gồm năm chức vụ lãnh đạo khác nhau ở chính quyền và doanh nghiệp nhà nước, bắt đầu ở các năm khác nhau, nên cần gom nhiều mốc.
criterion: beginning a government or state-enterprise leadership post in Taiwan (presidency, membership of a commission, headship, or ministerial term)

gold_events.text: Became president of the Taiwan Shipbuilding Corporation.
Appointed member of the Industrial Development Commission.
Became head of the Industrial Development and Investment Center.
Began term as economic minister of Taiwan.
Began term as finance minister of Taiwan.

question: How many years passed between his graduation from National Central University and his receipt of the Ramon Magsaysay Award for government service?
why_needs_multiple: Câu hỏi cần hai mốc cụ thể là tốt nghiệp đại học và nhận giải thưởng để tính khoảng cách giữa chúng.
criterion: his graduation from National Central University and his receipt of the Ramon Magsaysay Award

gold_events.text: Graduated from National Central University (Nanjing University).
Received the Ramon Magsaysay Award for government service.
